CONVERSATION.NAME: Mess with Melissa's Confidence
CONVERSATION.DESCRIP:
Melissa is planning to confess her feelings to Matthew on stage, winning him over with a song. Stop her.
UNSURE: Give Melissa a case of stage fright.
HUMILATED: Remind Melissa of her flaws so she loses her nerve.

CARD.NAME: Break a leg!
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Hey, good luck up there. You know, if you're considering bowing out, there's still time.

CARD.NAME: Hopeless.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Begging Matthew for attention in front of everyone. You don't think it's going to come across as a little pathetic?

CARD.NAME: Insecurity
CARD.DESCRIPTION: All your dialog making Melissa unsure is stronger.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: +1 to all my cards of unsure,

CARD.NAME: No ambition.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Matthew is a driven guy, what would he want with someone who spends her whole day doing nothing but sitting around?

CARD.NAME: Out of tune
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Last time you sang I heard you were totally out of tune. I guess you had a cold or something, right?

CARD.NAME: Rumor: Everyone knows about your scar.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You know everyone knows about that nasty scar right? They're all out there pity the poor deformed drunk girl on stage.

CARD.NAME: Rumor: Melissa's drinking problem.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You sure you're not too nervous to get up there? Maybe you should have a drink?

CARD.NAME: Rumor: Melissa's many boyfriends.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I've heard stage fright can be cured by imagining everyone in the audience is naked, which should be easy for you since you've slept with all of them.

CARD.NAME: Secret: Melissa's mom.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You're setting yourself up for a big failure here. It's so self-destructive. You're totally following the same path as your mom.

CARD.NAME: Secret: Melissa's performance anxiety
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I don't know how you do it, going up there in front of all those people. Your stomach must be knots the whole time.

CARD.NAME: Secret: Melissa's scar
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I'm betting Matthew doesn't know about that nasty scar of yours. I think I'm going to go tell him.

CARD.NAME: Secret: Melissa's secret love?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You've been "secretly" in love with him for how long? He already knows Melissa, and why hasn't he said anything? Maybe he doesn't feel the same? Maybe he doesn't want to humilate you.

CARD.NAME: Singer or Dancer?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You're kind of out of you element huh? Have you even been on a stage without a pole?

CARD.NAME: So much for a happy ending?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You don't think it's a little much -- a big on stage confession? These things don't always have a happy ending. This isn't a movie you know.

CARD.NAME: Stage Fright
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Boy, I do not envy you. All those eyes watching your every move, all those people waiting, wondering "Is she any good? What makes her think she's so special?". That's so intense! Good luck!

CARD.NAME: What if it doesn't work?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: What are you going to do if this doesn't work? Matthew is going to be embarrassed for you, and everyone else will be laughing at you.

CARD.NAME: Defiant.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Who are you to give me advice? No guy wants you!

CARD.NAME: I'm not afraid
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Whatever happens is meant to happen.

CARD.NAME: I'm not listening!
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I can do this. I can do this. I can do this. I can do this.

CARD.NAME: I'm talented
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Everyone tells me how much they like my songs.

CARD.NAME: Like you could do better
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If you think you could do better be my guest, you don't have a talented bone in your body.

CARD.NAME: Matthew likes me for being me
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Matthew already knows about all my issues, and he still loves me for who I am.

CARD.NAME: Practice makes me perfect.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I've been practicing forever and this is my moment to shine, I don't care what you say.

CARD.NAME: Pride
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Melissa is feeling proud, improving any of her dialog that decreases humilation.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -1 to all my cards of humilated,

CARD.NAME: Rumor: Matthew's been waiting
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You know why Matthew hasn't had a girlfriend in so long? He's been waiting for me to confess my feelings. I know it.

CARD.NAME: We have a real connection
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Matthew and I have a strong and real connection! You two have nothing in common.

CARD.NAME: You've got your own agenda
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You've always been trying to come between Matthew and me, why should I care what you have to say?
